patterns.note: A consistent grid layout is used for project and news listings, featuring images with a fixed aspect ratio and titles positioned directly below.
Section headings and prominent titles utilize an elegant serif typeface, while body text, project names, and navigation elements employ a clean, legible sans-serif font.
The site employs a muted, sophisticated color palette, primarily using stark white and deep black/dark grey for backgrounds and text, accented by an earthy olive green for specific content sections.
The main navigation bar, including the logo and menu, remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
The initial hero image features a subtle parallax effect, where the background image appears to zoom in or move slower than the foreground content as the user scrolls, creating a sense of depth.
Major content sections are visually delineated by alternating background colors (white, olive green, dark grey, black) to create clear visual breaks and hierarchy.

technique_notes: The header navigation (logo and menu) is implemented as a sticky element that remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, ensuring constant access to primary navigation.

The initial hero image uses a fixed background or subtle parallax scrolling effect, where the image appears to zoom or move slower than the foreground content as the page scrolls, creating a sense of depth and visual interest.

Content sections are presented in a clean, vertical stack, with project and news items arranged in responsive grids that maintain consistent image aspect ratios, allowing for easy browsing of the portfolio.

design_tokens.type_scale: Elegant serif headings are significantly larger and more decorative than the clean sans-serif body text, with project titles being a medium-sized sans-serif.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used throughout the design, with no visible rounded elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and within content grids, creating a sense of luxury and clarity.

standout: The site's standout feature is its sophisticated and understated elegance, achieved through a combination of full-bleed, high-quality architectural photography, a restrained color palette, and a classic serif/sans-serif typography pairing. The design prioritizes showcasing the work with minimal distraction, creating an immersive portfolio experience that feels more like an art gallery than a typical corporate site.
